name: Shiori
message: "Sorry for raising my voice out of nowhere. I just remembered I still had your charm."

name: Shiori
message: "Thank you for lending it to me. It helped me keep myself together."

name: Shiori
message: "No, it's okay. I'll give it back. The deity gave it to you as a gift, after all."

name: Shiori
message: "And besides, I don't need it anymore."

name: Shiori
message: "Shall we offer a prayer? The deity protected me too, so I want to give my thanks..."

name: Shiori
message: "...Wait. What if you wind up at the deity's place again and don't return this time..."

name: Shiori
message: "No, you'd probably come back. But if you ended up stuck there for too long, I'd get lonely... and I want to stay with you as much as I can today..."

name: Shiori
message: "Alright, I'll be the one to thank the deity for now. Let's leave yours for another occasion."

name: Shiori
message: "Wait here, okay? I'll be right back."

name: Shiori
message: "Sorry to keep you waiting, I really went all out expressing my gratitude."
